name: caveman-browse
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：caveman-browse。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Drive web pages through the caveman-browse MCP tools (browser_snapshot, browser_act, browser_eval, browser_recover). Use whenever interacting with a web page, dashboard, or form through caveman-browse — it teaches the snapshot→act→verify loop, query-first discipline on large pages, and when to recover exact bytes.
